name: Euler Dy
plain: Euler with noise churn-like sigma inflation, plus an extra half-resolution model call taken on a downscaled 2×2 corner lattice of the latent. The extra step updates one pixel of every 2×2 block only. It is a port of the A1111 Dy idea, with extra steps gated by index.
math:
γ=max(s_churn/(N−1),√2−1), or scaled by 1−(i/(N−2))^s_dy_pow, N=len(sigmas). σ̂=σᵢ(1+γ). x ← x − ε√(σ̂²−σᵢ²) (subtracts noise). x+=d·(σᵢ₊₁−σ̂).
Extra step when i//2==1: c = x[...,1,1] of each 2×2 block, x0_c = model(c,σ̂), c += d_c·dt, write c back.

props.stages: 1, plus 1 half-resolution call on gated steps

providers.author: pamparamm
providers.note: cfg_pp and ancestral variants: sample_euler_dy_cfg_pp, sample_euler_ancestral_dy, sample_euler_ancestral_dy_cfg_pp

label: from code
surprise: Gate i//2==1 is true only for i=2 and i=3, so only those two steps get the extra call.

audit.note: N is inconsistent. ppm_dyn_sampling.py:108,110: gamma uses s_churn/(len(sigmas)−1) but the scale uses i/(len(sigmas)−2). No single N makes both (N−1) forms true.
